posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
I really hope that Spirit Island is nothing to do with the Multiverse. Controversial? Maybe.

I either want a new product to be definitely a Sentinels game with superhero characters and fighting villains and such (like Tactics) or I want it to be a totally seperate game. Don't give me something that's just vaguely Sentinels-flavoured for no real reason.

I guess it's kinda like the fact that I really like vegetarian foods, although I also occasionally eat meat. I'm good with a tasty grilled steak or a juicy piece of chicken and I'm good with a pepper stuffed with halloumi and lemon and pine nuts, or a bean chilli, but I'm not so keen on steak-flavoured soya protein or a chilli made with veggie mince (that fake ground beef stuff). The mileage of vegetarians may vary, but my analogy stands.
